title: DragonBall Z Abridged SPECIAL: Bardock: Father of Goku

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Long ago, on a planet long forgotten by time...

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A young hero was born; a righteous Saiyan warrior who would bring peace to the galaxy.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: This is the story of *another* Saiyan warrior, who slaughtered millions of innocents and brought terror to those who heard his name.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: ♫ Dare! Dare to believe you can survive ♫

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: ♫ You hold the future in your hand ♫

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: ♫ Dare! Dare to keep all your dreams alive ♫

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: ♫ The power is there at your command (Oh, oh!) ♫

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: ♫ Dare! There is a place where dreams survive ♫

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: ♫ It's calling you on to victory ♫
Group of Saiyan warriors laugh (except Bardock)

lines.speaker: Pumbukin
lines.text: And then I tell the guy, "Don't be angry. I'm just Saiyan!"

lines.speaker: Pumbukin
lines.text: And then I tore out his throat.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: Hey, Bardock. Heard you had another kid. Congrats.

lines.speaker: Pumbukin
lines.text: I bet it's Selypa. I see the way you two look at each other.

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: Nah; it'd never work out between us.

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: Are you kidding? She's a raging *dyke*.

lines.speaker: Selypa
lines.text: God, this is why I hate men!

lines.speaker: Pumbukin
lines.text: So, uh, why did we attack this rock in the first place?

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: I dunno. The mission briefing said this planet was full of psychics.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: Wait a second... Doesn't that mean they can see the future?

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: Don't you think they should have seen us coming?

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: Just because they're psychic doesn't mean they're smart.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: But, aren't psychics supposed to have unbelievable mental--?

lines.speaker: Kanassan
lines.text: OH, NO! THEY CAN SEE ME!

lines.speaker: Kanassan
lines.text: I have to stop you from destroying my race!

lines.speaker: Kanassan
lines.text: Now I have to kill you!

lines.speaker: Kanassan
lines.text: Now you too can see the future!

lines.speaker: Pumbukin
lines.text: Hey, Bardock. What do you think he meant about you seeing the future?

lines.speaker: Pumbukin
lines.text: Say nothing if you want me to eat the remains of that alien!

lines.speaker: Zarbon
lines.text: Lord Freeza, the reports are saying that Kanassa has been seized.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: [raspy] Thank you, Zarbon; that's very good to hea--

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Ah, sorry about that; I had something in my throat.

lines.speaker: Zarbon
lines.text: The reports say that it was overtaken by a group of low-level Saiyans led by... Bardock.

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: Yeah, that Bardock's a pretty cool guy.

lines.speaker: Zarbon
lines.text: He conquers planets and doesn't afraid of anything.

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: 'He must be earning their trust before he slaughters them all.'

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.text: Bardock, are you all right? Your heart rate skyrocketed.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.text: Well, you're on Freeza Planet Six Nine Two.

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: Man, you'd think with all his free time he'd come up with better names for his planets.

lines.speaker: Zarbon
lines.text: So Lord Freeza, now that we have Kanassa under our command, what shall we--?

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: Anyway, where's my team? Are they already on a new mission?

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.text: Yes; well, it seems that Freeza passed down a new mission just two hours ago.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.text: By the way - while you're here, would you like to see your son, Kakarrot?

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: Nah; think I'll pass. Didn't pay attention to Raditz when he was growing up.

lines.speaker: Scientist
lines.text: Oh, yes; and we both know how he turned out...

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: Hey there, Kakarrot. It's your Daddy!

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: 'Let's see what kind of power level we've got here... All right...'

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: There is no possible way this day could get any more disappointing...

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: Bardock's going to be so disappointed.

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: I think Bardock is the least of your concerns.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: Why? I don't understand. We've served Freeza loyally.

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: Seems Freeza wants you dirty Saiyans out of the picture... and I'm just willing enough to oblige him.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: Chances are, someday he's just going to kill you, too.

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: Yeah, well, see... I'm more of a "in-the-now" kinda guy.

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: And in this regard... you're probably gonna be both.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: You... you won't get away with this.

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: What looks like crap... feels like crap... and probably ain't gonna wake up in the mornin'?

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: Whoa, looks like I'm late to the party.

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: ...Oh. Oh, God! Guys... Tell me you're just resting in the blood of your enemies!

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: Oh, thank God, Toma; you're OK.

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: I'll be honest - you're the only one I really cared about.

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: Everyone else was kinda bland. 'Cept for Selypa.

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: She was the only one here with a decent pair of t--

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: He sent someone to... to take us out.

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: Oh, God! He sent the Ginyu Force?

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: Listen - it won't end like this!

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: We're not too far from a healing planet. We're gonna get you fixed up.

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: We'll get you better, we'll warn everyone else, and then we'll--

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: '...My best friend just died in my arms, didn't he?'

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: 'Don't worry, my friends. You shall all be avenged.'

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: 'If Freeza's afraid of us, I'm gonna *give* him something to be afraid of!'

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: 'They don't know I'm still alive... and I'm gonna rain hot vengeance down upon every single one of those *sons of bi--*!'

lines.speaker: Eachpe
lines.text: All right, guys; let's hit the sho--

lines.speaker: Lemi
lines.text: Keep sharp! These Saiyans can pull off all kinds of tricks!

lines.speaker: Lemi
lines.text: You have to be very careful--

lines.speaker: Lemi
lines.text: You're the one who killed him, you ass!

lines.speaker: Mango
lines.text: Oh gee, Lemi; I never thought of it like tha--

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: 'Man, I can't believe they lost to these guys!'

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: For years, you've kept us under your foot [...]

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: 'I understand what I have to do now...'

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: 'And nothing is going to stop me!'

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: ♪ Do-do-do, another one bites the dust ♪

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: ♪ Dodo-do-do-do, another one bites the dust ♪

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: ♪ And another one gone, and another one gone ♪

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: ♪ Hey, I'm gonna get you too ♪

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: You really do soil yourself when you die!

lines.speaker: Operator 1
lines.text: All right, little guy. Time to send you to Planet... "Ee-arth".

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: So~ How did the mission go~?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: So, you're absolutely sure you killed every single living thing on that planet?

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: Uh-uh-uh-I'm sorry, Lord Freeza. I'll go take care of it right away!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: He's already on a direct course for Planet S.O.L.
Radio is turned off as Saiyans fall silent

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: Listen to me! We don't have much time.

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: Freeza's on his way here and he plans to kill us all!

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: We have to raise an army, and--

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: What are you, stupid?! Do you--?!

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: Eugh! Do you idiots even get it?

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: Freeza's about to commit genocide on our ENTIRE RACE!!

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: You know what? F*** it! I'm done!

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: I hope you all die and go to HELL!

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: 'Screw them! I don't need an army.'

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: 'I took on those elites; I can take on this tyrant!'

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: Freeza must be stopped... no matter the cost!

lines.speaker: Zarbon
lines.text: Lord Freeza, Bardock is approaching from the planet--

lines.speaker: Soldier
lines.text: Ey yo Bardock, I'm really happy for ya, and I'ma let you finish, but--

lines.speaker: Zarbon
lines.text: Sir, I think he wishes to have words.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Oh, what*ever* gave you that impression?

lines.speaker: Zarbon
lines.text: Well, he does keep on shouting your name.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Just get my freaking bubble car.

lines.speaker: Zarbon
lines.text: And that Bardock was such a dashing rogue...

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: There you are, Freeza! I've been looking for you.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Well, I'm not exactly *hard to find*!

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: We've had enough of this! We're *done* working for you, Freeza!

lines.speaker: Mook
lines.text: Uh, just so you know, that man does not speak for us!

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: We're here to kill you, and take our planet for our own!

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: For years, you've kept us under your foot [...]

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: '"Blah, blah, blah, injustices. Blah, blah, blah, tyranny."'

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: '"Blah, blah, blah, injustices. Blah, blah, blah, tyranny. Blah, blah, blah, Freeza, stop killing me!"'

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: '*God*, does he have any idea how hard it is to run an empire?'

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: 'I've got *other* things to do today, you know...!'

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: 'Like decide what wine will I have for dinner tonight...'

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: 'White wine? Red wine? Or dare I say...'

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: 'Oh, perhaps I should give Cooler a call. His birthday's coming up.'

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: [...] end your miserable life, once and for all!

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: 'Well, I'd say I should have seen this coming, but that would be ironic...'

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: 'He fights... a giant green bug... man...'

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: '...Oh, no. It's dark again! Where...? What is...?'

lines.speaker: Don Para
lines.text: I'm gonna lay this one down thick like whole milk!

lines.speaker: Bardock
lines.text: 'And I now welcome the sweet embrace of death...'

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: It seems that your brother is destroying ze Planet Vegeta!

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Very impressive, killing off a bunch of monkeys.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Any liquored-up hillbilly with a shotgun could have done that at the zoo...

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: Wait, sir! It seems he has missed one ship.

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: We are within range to intercept--

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: And so, Planet Vegeta was destroyed, along with all its inhabitants... save a lone Saiyan child... and his brother.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: ...And a renegade monster and his father.

lines.speaker: Nappa
lines.text: Well, I've got good news... aaand bad news.

lines.speaker: Nappa
lines.text: The *bad* news is... reports say our entire planet has been destroyed by a gigantic meteorite along with all its inhabitants.

lines.speaker: Nappa
lines.text: But the good news is we're going to Dairy Queen!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Just take me to the damn queen, Nappa.

lines.speaker: Nappa
lines.text: Yaaaay! This seems like the beginning of a beauuuutiful friendship...
Sounds of crying in the distance

lines.speaker: Grandpa Gohan
lines.text: Oh, look. Someone threw out a perfectly good baby.

lines.speaker: Grandpa Gohan
lines.text: I think I'm gonna call you...

lines.speaker: Grandpa Gohan
lines.text: Yes! Goku! You like that, huh? Yes, you do!

lines.speaker: Grandpa Gohan
lines.text: ♫ Hikaru kumo o tsukinuke Fly Away (Fly Away) ♫ (Piercing the shining clouds, I fly away (fly away))

lines.speaker: Grandpa Gohan
lines.text: ♫ Karadajû ni hirogaru panorama ♫ (While a panorama spreads through my body)

lines.speaker: Grandpa Gohan
lines.text: ♫ Kao o kerareta chikyû ga okotte (okotte) ♫ (Kicked in the face, the Earth gets angry (gets angry))

lines.speaker: Grandpa Gohan
lines.text: ♫ Kazan o bakuhatsu saseru ♫ (And makes a volcano explode)

lines.speaker: Grandpa Gohan
lines.text: ♫ Toketa kôri no naka ni ♫ (Within the melted polar ice)

lines.speaker: Grandpa Gohan
lines.text: ♫ Kyôryû ga itara tamanori shikomitai ne ♫ (If there’s a dinosaur, I want to train it to balance on a ball)

lines.speaker: Grandpa Gohan
lines.text: ♫ Egao urutora zetto de ♫ (With a smile that’s Ultra-Z)

lines.speaker: Grandpa Gohan
lines.text: ♫ Kyô mo ai-yai-yai-yai-yai~ ♫ (Even today is ai-yai-yai-yai-yai~)

segments.title: I'm Just Saiyan
segments.quote: "Don't be angry. I'm just Saiyan!" ... And then I tore out his throat.

segments.title: Psychics Aren't Smart
segments.quote: Just because they're psychic doesn't mean they're smart. / I have to stop you from destroying my race! ...In the future! / We already did that.

segments.title: Doesn't Afraid of Anything
segments.quote: He conquers planets and doesn't afraid of anything.

segments.title: Dodoria's Riddle
segments.quote: What looks like crap... feels like crap... and probably ain't gonna wake up in the mornin'? / Is... Is it me? / And that's the punchline.

segments.title: Plan B
segments.quote: '...My best friend just died in my arms, didn't he?' 'Yep...' 'All right.' 'Plan B.'

segments.title: Another One Bites the Dust
segments.quote: ♪ Another one bites the dust ♪ ... It's in my Dodoria wounds!

segments.title: Blah Blah Blah, Injustices
segments.quote: 'Ohhh *Lord*, these heroic types with their *speeches*.' '"Blah, blah, blah, injustices."' ... 'Oh right; mass genocide.'

segments.title: Dairy Queen
segments.quote: But the good news is we're going to Dairy Queen! / Just take me to the damn queen, Nappa.

segments.title: Someone Threw Out a Perfectly Good Baby
segments.quote: Oh, look. Someone threw out a perfectly good baby. ... I think I'm gonna call you... "Clark".
